test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence

The woman lost much __to her body weight due to__ diabetes.

options.text: from her body weight due to
of her body weight due to
for her body weight due to
off her body weight due to

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**of**" correctly connects "**lost much**" with "**her body weight**."
 
• The phrase "**much of her body weight**" is the idiomatic expression that should be used here.
 
• The correct construction ensures clarity and correctness in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The woman lost much of her body weight due to__ diabetes."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "from her body weight due to" **– "From" is not a suitable preposition in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "for her body weight due to" **– "For" is not a suitable preposition in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "off her body weight due to" **– "Off" is not a suitable preposition in this context.
